roles.source: Connect-landed document/media artifacts and immutable source manifests
roles.target: M2D document/media metadata with graph linkage and readback provenance

transformClassification.evidenceBasis: This profile covers version-controlled metadata and linkage mappings only; M2D extraction and classification remain product runtime behavior outside this Transform configuration.

schemaShape: metadata vertices and document/media linkage edges
normalizationRules: media type, source category and received time
profileInputs: immutable media manifests and bounded sample tier
vocabularySelections: existing Lexicon document, media and provenance terms

invariants.description: Every source media object is bound to an immutable manifest and content digest
Hydrated media object counts and hashes reconcile with the source manifest
Every document/media relationship resolves to declared metadata and graph endpoints
Source, transformed, classified and readback artifacts retain immutable provenance

repositories.purpose: M2D preprocessing, classification, run tracking, and staging contracts

discoveryProbes.description: Locate staging, preprocessing, classification and run-tracker contracts
Resolve immutable source and transformed manifest digests
Bind processing runtime to source and configuration revisions
Read bounded run status and classified artifact counts
Read sanitized Interprose or seller reporting reconciliation

mapping.reason: No immutable registered Transform mapping source has been identified for this calibration profile.
No immutable registered reverse Transform mapping source has been identified for this calibration profile.

validationSources.reason: The profile remains a calibration contract until registered mappings and sanitized immutable fixtures exist.

identityRules: Use deterministic document/media identity derived by the registered mapping
Do not expose document, account or debt identifiers in evidence
endpointRules: Every media linkage resolves to declared document and artifact vertices
Dangling endpoint count must equal zero

adapters.name: interprose-document-fetch
adapters.contract: Connect lists and fetches Interprose documents; Transform receives landed files only

adapters.name: seller-encrypted-file-intake
adapters.contract: Connect lands and decrypts approved seller transfers before product preprocessing

adapters.name: classified-media-upload
adapters.contract: Connect uploads product-classified files through registered external adapters

consumers.name: m2d-preprocessing
consumers.contract: Owns archive unpacking, text extraction, classification and run tracking

consumers.name: persist-classification-readback
consumers.contract: Owns existing classification reuse and graph readback
